title: Q & A
lead: Answers from the class schedule, registration, and studio information.

items.question: When do classes start?
items.answer: Registration is now open for the 2026-2027 season. Classes begin Monday September 14th.

items.question: Where is the studio?
items.answer: Seaside Dance Academy is at 16 S Main St, Berlin, Maryland 21811.

items.question: How do I reach the studio?
items.answer: Call (410) 629-0377 or email seasidedanceacademy@gmail.com. Desk staff are available during operation hours.

items.question: What ages can take class?
items.answer: Dance & Grow 1 is for ages 3 and 4. The class schedule lists an age for every class.

items.question: How much does a class cost?
items.answer: Each class lists its price per month. Private lessons are $30 per half hour.

items.question: What if only a few dancers sign up?
items.answer: Classes with less than 4 dancers are subject to cancellation due to low enrollment.
